platform: Linux x86-64, CUDA, NVIDIA RTX 5090, 32 GiB

models.code2wav: BF16 weights expanded to F32 on GPU

benchmark.note: Historical scheduling candidate, ten serial/concurrent pairs after warmup. Short prompts in an allocated 65K context, not a 65K-token prompt. All timings retained; GPU timings fluctuate.

forced_paging.note: Accounting-budget test on the same 32 GiB GPU; not qualification of a 3.6 GiB GPU.

kv_growth: passed: all KV bytes preserved at positions 512, 1024 and 1299 against preallocated reference

builds.cuda: isolated module linked to matching previously qualified upstream/CUDA libraries; native numerical and model tests passed

regressions.duplex_state_machine: passed (overlap, rollback, playback acknowledgements, completed-synthesis interruption, 100 tiny fragments, PCM joining, limits, cancellation, disconnected/full output queue, worker errors)
regressions.authentication: all 7 Omni routes reject missing/wrong keys and accept the test key
regressions.legacy_voice: 3 multi-turn audio requests, forced empty output error and recovery passed
regressions.legacy_client: PCM ordering, stale generations, missing EOF and error cleanup passed
regressions.thread_sanitizer: passed: final duplex state-machine/audio tests instrumented with GCC ThreadSanitizer; no reported races

scope: One native session, one Thinker lane and one speech lane.
Playback positions were simulated by test clients; physical microphone/speaker echo cancellation and device playback are not qualified.
Bit-identical PCM proves scheduler/paging preservation for the tested seeded fixture, not broad perceptual speech quality.
Other GPUs, backends, multiple speech GPUs, near-full concurrent multimodal prompts and physical low-VRAM devices still require qualification.
The cumulative audio frontend is upstream mtmd; partial snapshots are re-encoded.

cuda_incident.phase: serial speech generation in a final smoke run, before concurrent input

compute_sanitizer.api_status_910: The existing upstream cudaGraphExecUpdate fallback reports/recoverably clears status 910 and re-instantiates its graph (ggml-cuda.cu). These expected API diagnostics are distinct from invalid memory accesses.

preliminary_benchmark.note: Short prompts in an allocated 65K context, not a 65K-token prompt. Three serial/concurrent pairs after warmup; GPU timings fluctuate.

qualification_scope: Historical native scheduling candidate before subsequent adaptive-mode changes. Current release preparation is documented in root RELEASE_VALIDATION.json.
